claim: Transparency and explainability are a named principle.
Accountability is a named principle for trustworthy AI.

locator: Recommendations for policymakers: Shaping an enabling interoperable governance and policy environment for AI
claim: The policy recommendations explicitly include interoperable governance.
Explanations should reflect context and impact; affected people should be able to seek reasons and review.
Oversight, impact assessment, audit and due diligence support accountability across the AI life cycle.
Responsibility remains attributable to people or legal entities; delegation does not remove ultimate human accountability.
The Compact commits to promoting transparency, accountability and human oversight consistent with international law.
Shared practices and collaboration among standards organizations are routes toward compatible governance approaches.
Inclusive participation and a UN Global Dialogue are commitments in the adopted text.
